name: Shokuju
source:
Researchers have discovered a plant unlike any other -- one that grows like tentacles.
Its reproduction is a mystery, and so they choose one of their own as a test subject...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ267064.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
